services.value: TEST provides state-certified drinking water and N.P.D.E.S. wastewater laboratory analyses, plus environmental laboratory analyses for industry, municipalities, and commercial/residential clients. It also offers water, storm, and wastewater sample collection and pick-up, portable flow meter services, landfill gas monitoring, in-the-field analyses with portable instruments, and installation of 24-hour composite samplers and recording rain gauges and pressure instruments.
